sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

One of the game's most challenging features is the limited number of lives. Players have only one life per level, and if they fall, they must start over. This adds an extra layer of difficulty and tension to the game, making it even more challenging and addictive.

Despite the challenges, the game's controls are intuitive and easy to use, making it accessible to players of all skill levels. The game's physics engine is also well-designed, with realistic animations and reactions that make the game feel more immersive and engaging.
